key_insight: PhysRepair turns video generation into a generate-diagnose-repair loop, using causal reasoning to locate the first physical inconsistency and repair only the affected region while preserving the rest.
engineering_relevance: For computational mechanics and fracture-related video synthesis, the method improves physical plausibility without sacrificing the diversity and fidelity of the original generated motion.
method: Spatiotemporal Causal Constraints: find the first invalid physical state and trace causally affected states.
Local repair specification: regenerate only the inconsistent spatiotemporal region instead of the full video.
Experience-augmented in-context learning: reuse prior repair cases to adapt decisions across different physical failures.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports consistent improvements on Physics-IQ Verified across solid mechanics, fluid dynamics, optics, thermodynamics, and magnetism.
watch_item: The approach depends on reliable failure localization and prior repair trajectories, so performance may be sensitive to noisy physical diagnosis or sparse experience in new failure modes.
paper_title: Agentic Physics-Grounded Video Generation via Memory-Augmented In-Context Reasoning
